verdicts.note: Core confirmed: explain.go 3638 lines, 1020 comment lines, 88 cite issue/review numbers, 24 of 27 commits are fix/review. The 2446-3358 family (candidateSatisfies, numericExample, snapMultiple...) is reached only from exampleValueFor (explain.go:2379,2398) to synthesize examples. Caveats: schemaOwnKeywordsMatch (2575) is also used by repair.go's null handling, so deleting it breaks repair unless finding 2 lands first. Synthesized examples are scoped fragments (scopedBranchExample, branchValueExample), not whole-call args, so validating them with the root compiled schema needs the example assembled into full args first. t.Schema.Validate is in hand at session_tool_repair.go:193, so a validator func is feasible.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Order: finding 6 (behavior-level tests), then finding 2 (repair gets its own accepts-null probe), then replace candidate/numeric synthesis: generate the simplest candidate (const/enum first value, type placeholder), assemble it into full args, validate with the compiled schema func passed into ExplainSchemaError, and omit the Example line when invalid. Delete the 2446-3358 family only after both prior steps. Collapse the three example generators and required-name helpers. Needs Jesse's decision on model-facing text. Product docs do not list coaching behaviors (no match in docs/product), so no subsystems.md edit unless behavior changes.

verdicts.note: Linecap doc admits the duplication and the ReadSlice/ErrBufferFull state machine is present in transcript.go:337, jobstore/output.go:1326, retained_output_read.go:356, linecap.go:69, llm/apilog/codec.go:110. But policies differ: jobstore grepReaderLimit marks lines overlong and still emits a match with an overlong flag; retainedLineScanner keeps up to a cap and reports oversized plus byte offsets; linecap drops the line and drains. They are not drop-in. -250 is optimistic.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Do only the declared duplicate first: transcript.ReadLine as thin adapter over linecap.ReadLine, pinned by tests for EOF/over-limit/unterminated tail. Evaluate retained and jobstore separately and migrate only if linecap.ReadLine's consumed/terminated returns express their oversized semantics; otherwise leave them.

verdicts.note: Flock hits: 13 non-test files with unix.Flock/syscall.Flock (the 20 includes LockFileEx/windows). Only 4 use O_NOFOLLOW (installid, skill lease, sandbox scratch lock, app_instances_key, plus apilog_open_unix). The 'same sequence' claim holds for installid/lock_unix.go and skill/lease_unix.go, but they differ: lease takes SH or EX, treats ENOLCK/ENOSYS/EOPNOTSUPP as a no-op lease, checks replaced inode; installid chmods 0600. Others (hostlock 36 lines, plugins/locks_unix 24, transcriptindex, selfupdate) are not copies of that sequence. Not verified that an execsupport package exists in both modules. '12 places' and -600 are overstated.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Extract a helper only for the 3-4 O_NOFOLLOW+regular-file copies (installid, skill lease, sandbox scratch lock, app_instances_key), with options for shared/exclusive and unsupported-fs fallback; leave the simpler flock users alone. Jesse picks the home package.
